### Trip-Planning Summary: Downtown Chicago to Aurora, IL

---

### 1. Recommended Public Transit Route
* **Main Transit Mode:** **Metra Commuter Rail — BNSF Line** (boarding at Chicago Union Station, arriving at Aurora Transportation Center).
* **Estimated Total Travel Time:** Approximately **1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 27 minutes** overall from downtown Chicago (the direct Metra train ride itself takes about **50 to 57 minutes** depending on the train schedule/stops, plus brief walking or local transit connections to Union Station).

---

### 2. Metra BNSF Line & Fare Context
* **What the BNSF Line Is:** Metra’s Burlington Northern Santa Fe line is one of the highest-ridership commuter rail corridors in the Chicago metropolitan area.
* **Where It Runs:** Runs southwest/west from **Chicago Union Station** (210 S. Canal St.) out to **Aurora** (233 N. Broadway), serving communities across the western suburbs including Cicero, Berwyn, Riverside, Brookfield, LaGrange, Western Springs, Hinsdale, Clarendon Hills, Westmont, Downers Grove, Lisle, and Naperville.
* **Fare Information Location:** On the BNSF line page, direct price charts are not in the station listing; rather, fare details are accessed via the main navigation under **Fares** (`metra.com/fares`) and the **Fare Table** (`metra.com/fare-table`).
* **Fare Structure (Zone 1 Union Station to Zone 4 Aurora):**
  * **One-Way Ticket:** $6.75 (Full Fare) / $3.25 (Reduced Fare)
  * **Day Pass:** $13.50 (Full Fare) / $6.50 (Reduced Fare)
  * **Weekend Options:** $7 Saturday/Sunday/Holiday Day Pass, or $10 Weekend Pass on the Ventra app.

---

### 3. Aurora, IL Weather Forecast (Next 3 Days)
* **Friday, September 18:** High **73°F** / Low **62°F** (Partly cloudy, 24% precip)
* **Saturday, September 19:** High **72°F** / Low **65°F** (Showers/rain likely, 90% precip)
* **Sunday, September 20:** High **70°F** / Low **59°F** (Rain/thunderstorms likely, 80% precip)

*Note:* Friday offers pleasant temperatures with low rain chances, while Saturday and Sunday carry significant chances of rain.

---

### Open Browser Tabs Reference
The requested pages have been kept open across your tabs for easy review and comparison:
* **Tab 1 (Tab ID `480038377`):** Google Maps Transit Directions (`Downtown Chicago, IL to Aurora, IL`)
* **Tab 2 (Tab ID `480038480`):** Metra BNSF Line Page (`https://www.metra.com/train-lines/bnsf`)
* **Tab 3 (Tab ID `480038481`):** Metra Fares & Ticket Pricing Page (`https://www.metra.com/fares`)
* **Tab 4 (Tab ID `480038482`):** Weather.com 10-Day Forecast for Aurora, IL (`https://weather.com/us/illinois/city/aurora/tenday`)
